summary.text: Chris Chapman is the Democratic candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 69, in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.
An information technology professional and engineer, he also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Chapman was the Democratic candidate for Missouri House District 69 in 2024, when Republican Scott Miller won the general election with 57.7 percent of the vote to Chapman's 42.3 percent.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Chapman described himself as an engineer raised in a working-class home.
Chapman said in the survey that he is committed to fully funding Missouri public schools and opposes vouchers.
He said he wants to lower the state income tax and end the state grocery tax, and that he supports labor unions and veterans' health care.
He also said he wants to regulate energy-intensive data centers and tax artificial intelligence operations.
